hints: I2C and PWM are software on the ESP8266: a net with fn i2c or pwm finds no hardware function here

radio.source: ESP-12F product specification V1 (2018), table 1.1: frequency range 2412 ~ 2484 MHz, PCB antenna; Wi-Fi radio: PA output power in 11b mode 19.5 / 20.5 / 21.5 dBm (min / typ / max)

sources: Ai-Thinker ESP-12F WiFi module V1 product specification (2018, 15 pages), LCSC's copy https://datasheet.lcsc.com/datasheet/pdf/bb52afb9b0bdd84eff3377bbb6814e0f.pdf?productCode=C82891, read 2026-11-03

table 1.1: SMD22, 24 × 16 × 3 mm, 2412 … 2484 MHz, PCB antenna; power supply 3.0 … 3.6 V, typ. 3.3 V, 'current > 500 mA' – i_core_a 0.5 A, the current the supply must deliver, taken as the module's upper bound (as esp32-devkitc-v4's module); continuous transmission ~71 mA average, peak 500 mA; operating −20 … 85 °C

table 2.2 pins: 1 RST (active low), 2 ADC (0 … 1 V), 3 EN (active high), 4 IO16, 5 IO14 (HSPI_CLK), 6 IO12 (HSPI_MISO), 7 IO13 (HSPI_MOSI), 8 VCC 3.0 … 3.6 V, 9 GND, 10 IO15 (MTDO, HSPICS), 11 IO2 (UART1_TXD), 12 IO0, 13 IO4, 14 IO5, 15 RXD (GPIO3), 16 TXD (GPIO1) = the EasyEDA symbol of C82891 (edakit part import), whose 17 … 22 are the six flash pads underneath (CS0, MISO, GPIO9, GPIO10, MOSI, SCLK)
table 2.3 boot mode: run – EN high, RST high, GPIO15 low, GPIO0 high, GPIO2 high, TXD0 high; download – GPIO0 low (strap)
3. electrical characteristics: VDD 2.7 / 3.3 / 3.6 V, VIL ≤ 0.25 VIO, VIH ≥ 0.75 VIO (≤ 3.6 V), VOL ≤ 0.1 VIO, VOH ≥ 0.8 VIO, IMAX 12 mA (gpio_i_max_a)
Wi-Fi radio: input frequency 2400 … 2483.5 MHz, PA output 11b 19.5 / 20.5 / 21.5 dBm; power consumption: TX 11b 170 mA typ (50 % duty), modem sleep 20 mA, deep sleep 20 µA

open: 'some of the pins inside the module have been pulled up or down, please refer to the schematic' (table 2.3 notes) – the module's schematic was not read: no pulls entered
the PCB antenna's gain is not stated – LIM.eirp cannot compute the e.i.r.p.
the ESP8266EX's own datasheet was not read; the module sheet's values are used
